overview: A tenant in a Commercial Real Estate (CRE) lease is a business, organization, or individual that rents space—such as office, retail, or industrial property—from a landlord for business operations. They are responsible for paying rent and adhering to agreed-upon terms, which may include maintenance, usage limitations, and insurance.

General Applicability: All leases (Office, Retail and Industrial)
